findings.summary: Replay does not verify the sealed validity digest. `_validity_allows` reconstructs a key from persisted `fields` using `binding_key_from_fields`, but `binding_key_from_fields` ignores the persisted `digest` and recomputes one from those fields. Consequently, a receipt whose validity digest was modified or corrupted can still be replayed whenever its fields remain unchanged, instead of producing a traceable fail-closed validity-evidence refusal. The same digest omission also affects Goal-gate comparison through the same helper.
